headline_en: US-Iran deal confirmed, oil at lows; semis mixed ahead of earnings

CRWD and ALAB show strongest setups with Stage2=7/6 and RS≥100 in UPTREND structure.
DXY at 101.05 and VIX 16.90 signal moderate caution; avoid DOWNTREND names with low Stage2 scores.

CRWD와 ALAB가 Stage2 7/6점과 RS 100 이상으로 가장 탄탄한 상승 추세 구조

market_mood.explanation_en: The 69.1 regime score sits in constructive territory, like a boat moving forward but against a mild headwind. Investors can look for selective entries in strong UPTREND names while keeping position sizes modest.

big_picture.summary_en: US-Iran peace deal is complete and Hormuz traffic is resuming, driving WTI lower. Reports indicate Taiwan Strait tension persists as a developing risk factor for semiconductor supply chains despite the US-China tariff framework remaining stable and elevated.

big_picture.vix_note_en: VIX sits at 16.90, indicating calm rather than fear or overconfidence in the market.

big_picture.rates_note_en: 10-year yield at 4.57% creates mild pressure on growth stocks by raising discount rates.

big_picture.dollar_note_en: The dollar index (DXY) is at 101.05, a modest headwind for tech multinationals with overseas earnings.

big_picture.btc_note_en: Bitcoin is at $62029.91, down 2.00% today and 0.82% over five days. This signals reduced risk appetite across speculative assets.

sector_analysis.leaders_en: No sector shows clear technical leadership; the semiconductor group (SMH) prints RED with DISTRIBUTION structure across multiple names.

sector_analysis.laggards_en: Semiconductors lag due to red macro signal and DISTRIBUTION/DOWNTREND structures in NVDA, META, TSLA, AMZN, GOOGL despite AI demand narratives.

issues.current_state_en: US declared Iran peace deal complete on June 15; Hormuz transit applications open with Korean vessels exiting, WTI trading below $68.50-$70 amid higher expected supply.
issues.current_state_ko: 6월 15일 미국이 이란 평화협정 완료 선언, 호르무즈 통행 신청 개방 및 한국 선박 이탈 중, WTI 68.50~70달러 이하 거래.
issues.summary_en: US-Iran ceasefire and Hormuz reopening confirmed via multiple outlets in mid-June; oil prices tumbled to four-month lows as traffic climbs and supply expectations rise. Reuters/Bloomberg-aligned reporting shows easing risk premium directly feeding lower energy costs.
issues.summary_ko: 6월 중순 미-이란 휴전 및 호르무즈 재개 확인, 유가 4개월 최저치로 하락하며 공급 기대 상승. 에너지 리스크 프리미엄 축소가 유가 하락으로 직결.
issues.source_hint: TMGM / CoinDesk June 2026 reports citing official statements
issues.asymmetric_impact_en: VST/CEG: negative (lower oil prices reduce power demand); SPCX: neutral to negative (energy exposure); NVDA/TSM: positive (lower input costs, risk-on tech rotation); TSLA: positive (cheaper energy supports EV margins).
issues.asymmetric_impact_ko: VST/CEG: 부정 (유가 하락으로 전력 수요 감소); SPCX: 중립~부정 (에너지 노출); NVDA/TSM: 긍정 (원가 절감 및 리스크온 테크 로테이션); TSLA: 긍정 (저렴한 에너지로 EV 마진 지원).
issues.market_insight_en: Watch WTI rebound above $72 as trigger to reduce energy longs; position in rate-sensitive tech on sustained de-escalation.
issues.market_insight_ko: WTI 72달러 상회 시 에너지 롱 축소 트리거 주시, 지속 완화 시 금리 민감 테크 비중 확대.

issues.title_en: US-China semiconductor tariffs remain case-by-case post-summit
issues.title_ko: 미중 반도체 관세 정상회담 후 사례별 적용 유지
issues.current_state_en: Post-May 2026 Trump-Xi summit, export controls shifted to transactional licensing with 25% tariff baseline; approvals still granted selectively rather than blanket ban.
issues.current_state_ko: 2026년 5월 트럼프-시진핑 정상회담 이후 수출 통제는 거래적 라이선스 + 25% 관세 기준으로 전환, 승인은 선택적.
issues.summary_en: Korea IT Times and Herald Economic coverage through mid-2026 confirms ongoing trade war framework with no full rollback; domestic rare earth investment accelerated in response. Market moves on each licensing decision rather than new legislation.
issues.summary_ko: 2026년 중반까지 무역전쟁 프레임워크 지속 확인, 완전 철회 없음; 희토류 국내 투자 가속. 라이선스 결정마다 시장 반응.
issues.source_hint: Korea IT Times / Herald Economic Jan-May 2026
issues.asymmetric_impact_en: NVDA: conditional positive on approval news / negative on denial; TSM: negative (supply chain friction); MU: negative (memory export pressure); APP/ANET: neutral (indirect exposure).
issues.asymmetric_impact_ko: NVDA: 승인 시 조건부 긍정 / 거부 시 부정; TSM: 부정 (공급망 마찰); MU: 부정 (메모리 수출 압력); APP/ANET: 중립 (간접 노출).
issues.market_insight_en: Track BIS licensing announcements weekly; hedge NVDA with TSM puts ahead of any new tranche decisions.
issues.market_insight_ko: 주간 BIS 라이선스 발표 추적, 신규 트랜치 결정 전 NVDA-TSM 풋 헤지.

issues.title_en: Taiwan Strait remains tense under fragile US-China detente
issues.title_ko: 미중 긴장 완화 속 대만해협 긴장 지속
issues.current_state_en: Post-summit security issues sidelined but no de-escalation in PLA activity; supply chain risk elevated without new military incidents in last 48h.
issues.current_state_ko: 정상회담 후 안보 이슈 보류됐으나 PLA 활동 완화 없음, 최근 48시간 신규 군사 사건 없으나 공급망 리스크 고조.
issues.summary_en: Nate and Yonhap reporting from May-June 2026 indicates security topics deferred at Trump-Xi meeting; no fresh drills cited but underlying tension persists as baseline for TSM exposure.
issues.summary_ko: 5~6월 보도에서 트럼프-시진핑 회담 시 안보 의제 보류, 신규 훈련 미확인이나 TSM 노출의 기본 리스크로 잔존.
issues.asymmetric_impact_en: TSM: negative (persistent supply risk premium); NVDA: negative (foundry concentration); MU: negative (memory chain overlap); RKLB: neutral (unrelated).
issues.asymmetric_impact_ko: TSM: 부정 (지속 공급 리스크 프리미엄); NVDA: 부정 (파운드리 집중); MU: 부정 (메모리 체인 중복); RKLB: 중립.
issues.market_insight_en: Maintain TSM volatility hedges; any PLA activity spike will pressure semis first before broader indices.
issues.market_insight_ko: TSM 변동성 헤지 유지, PLA 활동 급증 시 반도체 종목이 지수보다 먼저 압력 받음.

global_context.market_paradox_en: WTI at multi-month lows despite lingering Hormuz sovereignty claims signals market fully pricing de-escalation; VIX appears complacent relative to baseline Taiwan/China friction.
global_context.market_paradox_ko: 호르무즈 영유권 주장 잔존에도 WTI가 수개월 저점으로, 시장이 완화 국면을 완전히 선반영한 듯; VIX는 대만/중국 마찰 기준 대비 지나치게 안정적.
